p1.2: January, nineteen ninety. British back packer Paul Onions hitchhikes south of Sydney.
p1.5: Near Bel-ang-lo State Forest, he pulls over. Out comes the gun.
p1.9: Nineteen ninety-two. Runners in that forest find a body.
p1.11: Paul calls from England. In nineteen ninety-four, he identifies Bill.
p1.0: He pulled over beside a forest... and took out a revolver, and a rope.
p1.1: Every back packer knows the warning: never get in a stranger's car. In Australia, it came true.
p1.3: A man calling himself Bill offers him a lift.
p1.6: Paul runs onto the highway. Bill fires at him.
p1.7: A passing driver gets him, to the police.
p1.8: Nobody follows it up... for four years.
p1.10: In the end, seven back packers are found there.
p1.13: Seven life sentences. He died in prison, and never confessed.
p1.14: Paul is the man who got out of that car.
